name: Aleutian Current

primary_definition.interpretation: Eastward southern limb of the subpolar gyre; Oyashio outflow feeds it and eastern flow divides toward Alaska and California. No source-defined endpoint coordinates.

stream_study_context.limits: Study coverage and offshore section windows do not define named-flow endpoints or full widths. Pressure-reference velocity estimates remain separate from measured full-depth velocity.

remaining_gates: Diagnose Aleutian source-interface and eastern split with defensible time/layer support.
Preserve North Pacific Current exchange and frontage without treating mixing as a unique centerline.
Review Alaskan Stream identity separately; do not reuse any Aleutian geometry or length.
Separate cold Subarctic flow from warm Isoguchi jets; SST search bounds are not current gates or width edges.
